researcher_notes: Single 34pp German-language product folder covering the full Open Shuttle line (KiSoft FCS fleet software section = company_wide_context). Source file has 2 byte-identical duplicate copies in New/ ('-2-2.pdf', '-2-3.pdf') -- all 3 moved to Analysed/ together, only 1 extraction pass performed. IMPORTANT MAPPING ASSUMPTION: the brochure names five distinct products -- 'Open Shuttle Fork', 'Open Shuttle 50', 'Open Shuttle 100', 'Open Shuttle Boxgrip', 'Open Shuttle 50 ASG' -- and the DB has five rows, but one of them is named plain 'Open Shuttle' (no number) rather than 'Open Shuttle 50'. Assumed DB's 'Open Shuttle' == brochure's 'Open Shuttle 50' (the smaller of the two container-transport variants, since 'Open Shuttle 100' already has its own explicitly-numbered DB row) -- FLAGGED for Tech Lead confirmation, not verified against any other source. All 5 base models had every field NULL before this pass -- pure enrichment, no new products created. Recurring cross-product ambiguity: several sheets state a handover-height RANGE (e.g. '500mm-1.500mm Abgabe- und Aufnahmehöhen') as a headline figure, while the same model's own 'ADD-ON' features page separately describes the mechanism enabling that full range (integrated lift/hub) as OPTIONAL, not standard -- this is an internal inconsistency in the source document itself (not introduced by this agent); the upper-bound figure was used for lift_height in each case with this caveat repeated per-product. No navigation technology keyword (no 'SLAM', 'Laser Reflector', 'Kontur/Contour', etc.) appears anywhere in the 34 pages, so navigation_type is left null for all 5 products despite this being a KiSoft/KNAPP-wide product line. 'CE-zertifiziert' is stated as a STANDARD FEATURES badge on every product page -- this maps to AP0's Company-entity field certifications_generic (not a Base Model field), so it was NOT written into any product's 'fields' dict here; flagging in this note instead for the Tech Lead to apply at the Company level if desired.

company_wide_context.applies_to: all base models of this company (KiSoft FCS is KNAPP's shared fleet-control software for the whole Open Shuttle line)
company_wide_context.notes: p.26-27 'KiSoft FCS' section: 'Sie verwalten, steuern und koordinieren sämtliche Transportaufträge in einem System' (centralized order management) -> fleet_control_architecture=Centralized. 'KiSoft FCS ist ein Flottenkontroll-System für manuell und automatisiert betriebene Flurförderzeuge' (fleet control for BOTH manual and automated vehicles in one system) -> multi_fleet_capable=true. p.5 'NEHMEN SIE SELBSTSTÄNDIG INSTALLATIONEN, WARTUNGEN UND ÄNDERUNGEN AM SYSTEM VOR' + p.27 'Selbstständige Änderungen der Prozesse, Stationen und Fahrwege möglich' (customer independently performs installation/maintenance/changes) -> installation_process=Client, modification_process='Client: All'. p.27 also states 'Einfache Integration in bestehendes System ... Stand-alone-Lösung für Open Shuttles möglich' but names no specific WMS/ERP/MES/REST/OPC-UA system, so integration_capability left null rather than guessed.

field_sources.min_aisle_width: p.9 'OPEN SHUTTLE FORK: Einbahn (vmin) 1.400 mm' -- the narrowest one-way/minimum-speed corridor figure used as the vehicle's own minimum requirement; wider figures also printed for opposing traffic and max speed (Gegenverkehr vmin 2.700mm, Einbahn vmax 1.950mm, Gegenverkehr vmax 3.500mm, Drehkreis 2.700mm) but not used since min_aisle_width should reflect the narrowest condition the vehicle can actually operate in
field_sources.omnidirectional_movement: p.7 STANDARD FEATURES badge 'Omnidirektionaler Antrieb ohne Scherenhub'
field_sources.load_type: p.6 body text 'Paletten (Euro-, Industrie-, Halb- und Chep-Paletten), Gestelle, Regale, Sonderladungsträger' -- Euro-Paletten->Pallet EUR, Halb-Paletten->Half-Euro; Industrie-/Chep-Paletten and racks/shelves have no closer AP0 match than Custom Carrier
field_sources.barcode_readers: p.7 ADD-ON section 'Barcode-Detektion ermöglicht die eindeutige Identifizierung von Paletten' -- listed as an ADD-ON option, not confirmed standard equipment, recorded true with this caveat (same convention as other suppliers' optional-feature handling this run)

products.notes: Chep-pallet adapter and 3D obstacle detection also listed as ADD-ONs, not written to any field (no clean AP0 match beyond what's already captured). CE certification is a Company-level fact, see researcher_notes.

field_sources.lift_height: p.19 ADD-ON... actually STANDARD for this model: 'Integrierter Hub ermöglicht Abgabehöhen von 0 bis 1.000 mm (abhängig von der Behälterhöhe) und ist bei diesem Modell im Standard enthalten' -- unlike its siblings, explicitly stated as STANDARD (not optional) for Boxgrip
field_sources.max_payload: p.18 'Max. Nutzlast 25 kg pro Behälter' -- NOTE: this is stated PER CONTAINER ('pro Behälter'), and the same sheet says the vehicle carries up to 2 containers at once (see onboard_container_count) -- recorded as printed (25kg) rather than multiplying by container count, since the source never states a combined/total payload figure
field_sources.onboard_container_type: p.18 'Behälter mit seitlichen Öffnungen zum Greifen' (bins with side openings for gripping) -> 'Bin'
field_sources.picking_mechanism: p.19 STANDARD FEATURES badge 'Greifer' (gripper) as Lastaufnahmemittel -- mapped to AP0's 'Bin-transfer' (closest allowed_value for a gripper that physically transfers bins on/off the shuttle, as opposed to 'Autonomous arm' which implies a general-purpose robotic arm)

products.notes: max_payload's per-container basis (rather than total) is worth a reviewer's attention -- may understate this model's effective total capacity if it really does carry 2x25kg simultaneously.
